food_action.instructions: Select the next Minecraft food-management action from the observed state. Prioritize critical health, then urgent hunger, then preparing the requested food stock. Respect blocked actions. Do not invent food or animals.

criteria.eat: Eat an available safe meal when hunger is urgent.
criteria.cook: Cook available raw ingredients into safe meals.
criteria.bread: Craft bread from at least three wheat.
criteria.hunt: Hunt a nearby animal for food ingredients.
criteria.farm: Harvest ripe crops or prepare and manage a farm.
criteria.explore: Explore for food or missing supplies when local routes are unavailable.
criteria.wait: Wait for growing crops when no faster food route is available.
criteria.continue: Continue the original goal when food stock is sufficient and eating is not urgent.
criteria.stop: Pause work when health is critically low.
